description: This file defines a class for a 'SafeObject' module within the HTMLPurifier library. The class is responsible for configuring and setting up secure handling of <object> and <param> HTML elements to ensure safety while embedding objects like Flash videos.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to define a safe, configurable module for embedding objects like Flash in HTML, with safety measures to prevent malicious content.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the SafeObject module by adding 'object' and 'param' elements with specific attribute transforms to ensure safe embedding of objects, such as Flash, based on configuration parameters.
